offline_limitation: The Dockerfile has no vendored wheels and no digest-pinned base image. --network=none would fail at pip install unless a cache and base image were already present, and Phase 1 could not verify either.
reproducibility: A repeated build can resolve a different base-image digest and different package versions inside the declared ranges.
network_access_not_requested: Context exposure blocks Phase 2. Network access is a separate unresolved limitation and is not approved by this stage.
